overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a robust and highly targeted academic social media presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, reaching a combined audience of 3,580 followers. His content successfully targets researchers and data scientists with posts focusing on computational social science, disinformation studies, and software tools like CooRnet. Across all channels, his audience exhibits strong engagement, with Bluesky generating the highest relative engagement rates and LinkedIn generating the largest absolute volume of professional interactions.

contentThemes.description: Updates on software updates, algorithms, and computational methods for detecting coordinated inauthentic behavior on social networks.
Announcements regarding newly published peer-reviewed papers, research grants, and conference presentations.
Job openings and academic opportunities, including hiring postdoctoral researchers and recruiting PhD students.

recommendations: Capitalize on Bluesky's high engagement rate by hosting interactive threads or Q&A sessions around newly published computational research papers.
Utilize LinkedIn's strong absolute reach for professional milestones by adding visual elements, such as team photos or grant infographics, to further amplify sharing.
Increase posting frequency on Mastodon with direct links to GitHub repositories or technical documentation for CooRnet to leverage the developer-heavy user base.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky serves as the most interactive platform relative to audience size, boasting an average engagement rate of 6.14%. It shows exceptional resonance for peer-to-peer sharing and academic recruitment.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides a highly technical audience segment (average engagement rate of 4.55%) that responds strongly to tool releases and methodological debates.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn acts as the primary driver of sheer reach and professional visibility, yielding 180 total engagements. Major career events and funding announcements perform exceptionally well here.
